people.name: Ephraim

people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there, and built Penuel.
translations.bsb: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. And from there he went out and built Penuel.
translations.kjv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
translations.asv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and he went out from thence, and built Penuel.
